text: The 2025 loss is not yet confirmed as persistent. Hansen/UMD detected a 13.5 ha tree-cover loss in 2025 within the asset, but this is the latest year of the series, so we lack corroborating data from subsequent years to confirm it was lasting. The change aligns with JRC 2020 forest data (98% agreement) and MGAP’s native forest map, but we cannot determine if it was deforestation, legal/illegal, or its cause (e.g., fire, logging). The claim remains pending until later-year observations or additional evidence are available.
